# vyos.blueprints.pppoe

PPPoE client with DHCPv6-PD (docs blueprint "PPPoE IPv6 Basic Setup for Home Network")

- Creates PPPoE client interfaces (credentials, service name, source interface) with optional IPv6 SLAAC on the WAN and DHCPv6 prefix delegation into LAN interfaces.
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no PPPoE module. The password is masked in rendered output.
- Pair with `vyos.blueprints.router_advert` for SLAAC on the LAN and `vyos.blueprints.firewall` for the IPv6 firewall.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.pppoe
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pppoe_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | PPPoE interfaces. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface name, e.g. `pppoe0`. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.source_interface` | str | yes |  | Ethernet interface towards the ISP, e.g. `eth0`. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.username` | str | yes |  | PPPoE username. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.password` | str | yes |  | PPPoE password. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.service_name` | str |  |  | Service name. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.mtu` | int |  |  | Interface MTU. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.default_route_distance` | int |  |  | Distance of the default route learned via PPPoE. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.ipv6_autoconf` | bool |  | `false` | Configure the WAN IPv6 address with SLAAC. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation` | list |  | `[]` | DHCPv6-PD requests and where the delegated prefix is used. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.id` | int |  | `0` | PD request id. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.length` | int |  |  | Requested prefix length. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.interfaces` | list | yes |  | LAN interfaces that get an address from the delegated prefix. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | LAN interface, e.g. `eth1`. |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.interfaces.address` | str |  |  | Interface identifier within the prefix, e.g. `100` (hexadecimal 0x64). |
| `pppoe_interfaces.prefix_delegation.interfaces.sla_id` | int |  |  | Subnet id within a larger delegated prefix. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every PPPoE session is up with an IPv4 address.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pppoe_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
